issues.description: The template's ArrayHelpers class defines a method named appendElement (appendElement(T[] array, T element)), but the template's Stock class (and the solution) call ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...). This name/signature mismatch between ArrayHelpers and its usage will cause compilation failures for students using the provided template. The solution repository uses addElementToArray, indicating the intended helper name is addElementToArray, so the template's differing method name is an unintentional structural inconsistency.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the helper method name consistent across the template and solution. Rename the method in the template's ArrayHelpers from appendElement to addElementToArray (matching the Stock usage and the solution), or alternatively update Stock to call ArrayHelpers.appendElement. Prefer updating ArrayHelpers in the template to provide addElementToArray to avoid confusing students and to match the solution.

issues.description: The array helper method used to append an element has inconsistent names across artifacts: the template's ArrayHelpers.java defines appendElementToArray(...) while other code (template's Stock.java and the solution's ArrayHelpers.java) call addElementToArray(...). This mismatch breaks the conceptual mapping for the single utility method that students are expected to use and will lead to compilation errors or confusion when following the exercise.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the helper method name across repositories. Rename the template ArrayHelpers.appendElementToArray(...) to addElementToArray(...), or change all callers (e.g., Stock.addToStockIngredients) to call appendElementToArray(...). Ensure the same method name is used in both template and solution so students have a consistent API to use.
